title: A Study of Fisetin to Treat Carpal Tunnel Syndrome

sections.abstract:
This research study is being conducted to investigate the safety and effectiveness of the drug Fisetin for mild or moderate carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS).

Posted outcomes: Change in Boston Carpal Tunnel Syndrome (BCTQ) Score. timeframe=Baseline, 60 days. Carpal Tunnel Syndrome=-0.5 (±0.6)
